intro: See a simple private snapshot of who showed up and how the community interacted. Community Analytics counts normalized StreamBridge activity locally; it never stores chat text, display names, avatars, money, or raw platform events.

sections.title: 1. Count community activity
sections.description: Choose the platforms to include. Everything else is automatic.
sections.notice: Recommended: enable all four platforms and leave simulated events off. Viewer Foundation supplies private identities; existing THSV intake actions supply events. No separate Streamer.bot import or trigger is needed.

sections.title: 2. Optional participation score
sections.description: Leave this off unless Viewer Spotlight should show a monthly score or rank.
sections.notice: The score uses only capped sessions, messages, and commands. It is not currency and never includes subscriptions, gifts, Bits, Jewels, donations, or other financial support.

sections.title: 3. Advanced: exclusions and storage
sections.description: Most creators can keep these defaults.
sections.notice: Bots and system actors are skipped automatically. Stable IDs are accepted for exceptions because display names can change or collide. Old records are removed automatically at the saved limits.
